content.rendered: Archer Glen’s Giving Tree for Sherwood 4 Kids Sake has had a wonderful participation by Archer Glen families this year. All the tags have been taken, but more tags will arrive today, Dec. 1st for families to pick up. All tags are for needy students in Sherwood for Christmas gifts in the $20 – $25 gift range. Tags will be available in the front office through Friday, Dec. 8th. All gifts need to be returned by Wednesday, Dec. 13th, unwrapped with the tag. The Sherwood 4 Kids Sake team will distribute the gifts to families before Christmas. Students may pick up a tag if they have a note from their parents.
